question:
Study the following diagram carefully and answer the question based on it.

The numbers in different sections represent the number of people playing different sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38847c6b7979f0a4ea183f1a083ba4727b73deeb8722f798add11943336a03cc.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2d732badfab478ed3f08dcb9ec3091800f0cb30029aaa5f42d55fb40e26eea1.png] 

How many people play both Hockey and Cricket but do not play Badminton?
solution:
According to the given information:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da618a1e363d4e9838c3dfee10770fa9c2595c1619782e3a88e614bcfebd974d.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2d732badfab478ed3f08dcb9ec3091800f0cb30029aaa5f42d55fb40e26eea1.png] 

Thus,** 5 **people play both Hockey and Cricket but do not play Badminton.

Hence, the correct answer is **"5".**
